newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Pernilla Wiberg, winner of a women's World Cup slalom on Saturday.

Overall World Cup wins: 15. Slaloms - Bad Kleinkirchheim (91), Waterville (91), Narvik (92), Steamboat (92), Veysonnaz (93, 95), Morzine (94), Lenzerheide (95), Semmering I (95, 96). Giant Slaloms - Lake Louise (91). Super-g - Cortina D'Ampezzo (94), Lake Louise (96). Combined - Sierra Nevada (94), Lenzerheide (95)

Other achievements: Gold medal giant slalom 1992 Olympics. Gold medal combined 1994 Olympics. Gold medal giant slalom 1991 world championships. Gold medals in slalom and combined 1996 world championships.

Wiberg, whose hobbies are singing and jewelry design, has been a regular on the World Cup circuit since 1990. A former technical specialist turned allrounder who is capable of winning in all five alpline disciplines. Overall World Cup title has been her goal for past years.
